title: Why are British place names so hard to pronounce?
summary: The Map Men explain why British place names are so hard to pronounce, tracing it to layers of Viking, Anglo-Saxon, Celtic and Norman influence, with a pronunciation guide.
why: Recommended as an entertaining, short explanation whenever British place names or their linguistic history come up.

quote.text: The Map Men on YouTube did a short (8min) video on why pronunciation is hard and a guide
